headline: Indian Oil Corporation to Trim Middle East Crude Term Purchases
summary: Indian Oil Corporation plans to slightly reduce its annual term purchases of Middle East crude oil for the 2027/2028 fiscal year due to supply uncertainty.
why: Indian Oil Corporation is India's top state-owned refiner, managing large-scale crude procurement contracts to fuel domestic energy demand.

impacts.name: Refining & Energy
impacts.why: Diversifying term crude sources alters traditional trade routes and supplier arrangements for major refiners.
